description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_pseudo_random_generator_decorator', a decorator for pseudo-random sequence generators that measures and reports metrics during generator operations.

classes.name: phy_metrics_pseudo_random_generator_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for pseudo_random_generator that adds metrics collection and reporting functionality.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a seed and reports metrics.

methods.name: init (overloaded)
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a given state.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the generator.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the generator by a specified count and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (bit_buffer, in)
methods.description: Applies XOR operation on buffers and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (span<uint8_t>, span<const uint8_t>)
methods.description: Applies XOR operation on byte spans and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (span<log_likelihood_ratio>, span<const log_likelihood_ratio>)
methods.description: Applies XOR operation on soft bit spans and reports metrics.

methods.name: generate (bit_buffer& data)
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random bits and reports metrics.

methods.name: generate (span<float> buffer, float value)
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random floats and reports metrics.
